title: Mouse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 72 Q14 70 16 56 Q18 48 26 50' stroke='#f2a0b5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#b8b0cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='11' ry='11' fill='#d8d2e8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M37 62 Q26 54 24 44' stroke='#b8b0cc' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 62 Q74 54 78 46' stroke='#b8b0cc' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='43' r='3' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='45' r='3' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M42 80 Q38 88 32 90' stroke='#b8b0cc' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 80 Q64 86 70 86' stroke='#b8b0cc' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='91' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='32' r='10' fill='#b8b0cc'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='32' r='10' fill='#b8b0cc'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='32' r='6' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='32' r='6' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='19' fill='#b8b0cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#d8d2e8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='3.2' fill='#2c2040'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='3.2' fill='#2c2040'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#ff7fa0'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M40 47 L28 44' stroke='#8a80a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 50 L28 52' stroke='#8a80a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 47 L72 44' stroke='#8a80a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 50 L72 52' stroke='#8a80a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#8ef2c0'/>
  <path d='M18.6 30 L18.6 20' stroke='#8ef2c0' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='24' r='2.6' fill='#8ef2c0'/>
  <path d='M86.6 24 L86.6 14' stroke='#8ef2c0' stroke-width='1.8'/>
</svg>
